findings.question: error-handling
findings.note: Completeness keyed on the check-* filename, so a gate shipped under another name (live example: claim-lint.mjs) escaped. Fixed: every .mjs under a skill's scripts/ must now declare a scope (new bootstrap-v2-helper for non-gates); an unmarked .mjs of any name is a violation. Tests: F1 case + helper-declared-passes.

findings.question: error-handling
findings.note: consumer-gate testSha256 was optional, leaving the consumer-gates that run in this repo's CI open to test-hollowing. Fixed: testSha256 now required and verified for gate AND consumer-gate; schema requires it. Test: F2 case.

findings.question: error-handling
findings.note: Reverse scan did not recurse into scripts/ subdirectories. Fixed: the scan now recurses. Test: F3 nested case.
